summary: End-to-end frontend verification of CloudPay (React) against the live preview URL. All 13 requested flows PASS. Login: empty fields (no prefill), invalid password shows 'Invalid email or password' error and stays on /login, valid super admin lands on /dashboard. Overview KPIs render (Gross turnover / Net volume / Success rate / Tenants + Volume by Status + Recent Payments). Tenant selector dropdown lists all seeded tenants including 'Acme Commerce'; switching to Acme repopulates all data-backed screens. Payments: created TEST-REF-1788286773 ($25 USD, mock/sandbox) via 'New Payment' -> Process, row appears in list with 'succeeded' status; Details opens (in-page detail with status). Refund: clicked Refund on a succeeded row, submitted, new refund $25 appears at top of /dashboard/refunds ('14d22deb succeeded requested_by_customer'). Providers list renders. Provider Health renders success-rate threshold panel (50%, min 5), Sandbox and Live sections, Provider Stability last-30-days panel and Alert Recovery Log heading. Hosted Checkout: Branding accent color save (#FF5722) PERSISTS after full page reload (input reloads with #ff5722). New Checkout Link modal opens, generated public URL /checkout/EwlJhrASqeknYpJbyVA_yXQ4euvfVwGX, opening it in a new tab renders a branded pay page containing 'Acme' and '$'. Webhooks: 'Add Endpoint' modal opens with Endpoint URL/Description/Events; existing endpoints appear in Delivery Inspector with real delivery attempts (previous endpoint https://example.com/wh-1788286942 shows 405 failed 1/8 attempts across payment.succeeded / refund.succeeded / provider.health_alert events, and a Replay action button — real delivery pipeline works). API Keys: 'Create Key' -> Generate produces 'sk_test_T9XNu4CSSVRzXb6Ge8uC5846-aSt4Qcu' shown once in a copy-secret modal (TEST-KEY-1788287041 active); Revoke button visible on active row. Reports: Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Custom selector present, Run report now generated a report row, Email delivery panel shows 'no provider connected' badge, form persists (verified iter 14). Admin/security pages (/dashboard/access-control, /dashboard/security, /dashboard/audit, /dashboard/features, /dashboard/monitoring, /dashboard/api-keys, /dashboard/webhooks) all render content (>4700 chars body) with no error boundary or page error. Security: Sign out redirects to /login; hitting /dashboard while logged out redirects back to /login (protected routes enforced). Only console noise: transient 401s from /api/auth/me polling before login completes and after logout — expected. No page errors and no error-boundary UI on any screen tested.

design_issues.screen: Global (all pages) after full page reload / direct navigation
issues: ACTIVE TENANT selector defaults to the first alphabetical tenant ('Sec Co') on hard reload/direct URL nav rather than persisting the previously selected tenant. SPA in-app link navigation preserves it correctly. Selection appears to live in AuthContext memory but not in localStorage — cosmetic UX nit only; all data screens are correct once the selector re-picks Acme. Consider persisting tenantId in localStorage.

critical_code_review_comments: Tenant selector state is not persisted across hard reloads (see design_issues). Low priority.
Console shows /api/auth/me returning 401 several times during the login handshake and after logout — noisy but not user-visible. Consider suppressing the pre-auth /me probe or catching 401 silently.
